title: Sanctuary Taro Boba Companion Drone
flow_prompt: Accompanied by a tiny, adorable dark-charcoal spherical helper drone hovering beside her right hand and carrying a purple taro milk-tea cup with a glowing coral straw, the companion glances warmly at her floating helper. The little charcoal drone performs a cheerful bobbing arc while she gives a relaxed, affectionate eye-smile and a gentle wave of her fingertips, then returns smoothly to her starting pose. Locked static camera, clean solid white studio backdrop, no floating text or overlays. Audio: no speech; a soft, cute two-note chime and the gentle clink of ice cubes in a dry studio with no background music.
